svg.title: Figure 3-SG-08-1. SG-08: from the fault tree to the FMEA
svg.desc: Figure 3-SG-08-1. SG-08: 14 events (backed 11, by design 0, external 2, unbacked 1); 12 FMEA modes reach SG-08 (in the tree 12, justified 0, tree gaps 0). Single points: BE-8.01: SFM-022, 4 causes, D 8–10, not detected; BE-8.02: SFM-022, 4 causes, D 8–10, not detected; BE-8.06: SWF-085, 2 causes, D 10, not detected; BE-8.07: SFM-023, SWF-061, 6 causes, D 4–9, partly detected; BE-8.08: SWF-086, 2 causes, D 8–9, not detected; BE-8.10: SWF-062, SFM-025, 2 causes, D 4, every cause D ≤ 4: tree and FMEA disagree. BE-8.01 (DM model false negative: eyes off the road or eyes closed classified attentive) → SFM-022: Inattentive driver not detected; worst cause SFM-022.C4 (Driver monitoring runs in demo mode while the item is engaged (IsDriverViewEnabled left set): the policy uses a synthetic vehicle state and the monitored seat can switch, so the actual driver may not be watched (GAP-20, TSR-610 not met); O 8, D 10, AP H); detection: As rated in the SW FMEA (SWF-085, D 10): no test covers demo mode with the item started BE-8.02 (Pose thresholds or the pose calibration wrong for the driver or the mount (policy.py:60-91)) → SFM-022: Inattentive driver not detected; worst cause SFM-022.C4 (Driver monitoring runs in demo mode while the item is engaged (IsDriverViewEnabled left set): the policy uses a synthetic vehicle state and the monitored seat can switch, so the actual driver may not be watched (GAP-20, TSR-610 not met); O 8, D 10, AP H); detection: As rated in the SW FMEA (SWF-085, D 10): no test covers demo mode with the item started BE-8.06 (DM demo mode (IsDriverViewEnabled) active while the item can engage: the policy runs on a synthetic vehicle state (zero calibration, fixed speed) and may switch the monitored seat while engaged, so a distracted driver can be judged against the wrong pose reference or seat (dmonitoringd.py:26-38, policy.py:286-291, 487-496; GAP-20, TSR-610)) → SWF-085: Driver monitoring evaluates the driver in demo mode while the item is engaged; worst cause SWF-085.C2 (No engagement interlock: nothing in selfdrived or controlsd reads IsDriverViewEnabled, so a parameter left set (written by tooling, or a UI crash before hide_event; it is cleared only at manager start, params_keys.h:61) keeps demo mode for the drive (GAP-20, TSR-610 not met); O 8, D 10, AP H); detection: No test; fault-injection scenario VS-FI-23 (params tampering) is specified in WP-V-05 but not run BE-8.03 (Driver camera or IR illumination degraded, covered or failed, or dmonitoringmodeld stopped (random HW)): No FMEA row yet; No DFMEA mode or FMEDA row: the DFMEA scope excludes the SoC side and the driver camera. The System FMEA has the cause (SFM-022.C3, driver camera or IR illumination degraded, cited on BE-8.01/8.02's mode), and no SW FMEA mode covers dmonitoringmodeld stopping. F-37 BE-8.04 (driverStateV2 always valid=True at the source (dmonitoringmodeld.py:99; GAP-21, TSR-609 not met)) → SWF-063: Driver state stale, frozen or non-finite while dmonitoringd treats it as valid; worst cause SWF-063.C1 (No finiteness or validity check: driverStateV2 is always published valid (dmonitoringmodeld.py:99) and neither process checks for NaN. By code reading a NaN pose with a finite std compares false against the pose thresholds, so the driver counts as attentive (policy.py:258-276); a NaN face probability counts as no face (the conservative direction). Not tested; O 4, D 10, AP H); detection: No test injects non-finite model output; dmonitoringmodeld is excluded from process replay and test_fuzzy, and model_replay is not run in CI BE-8.05 (Wheel-touch fallback resets awareness on any steering or gas input (policy.py:375-376; GAP-21, TSR-612 not met)) → SWF-061: Escalation of an inattentive or unresponsive driver later than the policy times; worst cause SWF-061.C3 (Exemptions reset or hold awareness: below 2.8 m/s awareness is held at the pre-alert level, and under the wheel-touch policy any steering or gas input resets it (policy.py:29, 376, 389, 502). A light accelerator touch satisfies the wheel-touch policy; O 6, D 9, AP H); detection: test_monitoring.py covers the wheel-touch fallback; not designed for this cause BE-8.07 (Policy timers, recovery factor or exemptions misconfigured (alerts later than 5/8/13 s; no monitoring below 10 km/h)) → SFM-023, SWF-061: Distraction escalation too slow; worst cause SFM-023.C2 (Low-speed or always-on exemption applied incorrectly; O 6, D 9, AP H); detection: As rated in the SW FMEA (SWF-061.C3, D 9 at BL-005): test_monitoring.py covers the wheel-touch fallback; not designed for this cause BE-2.12 (HMI hang: render loop or audio stream stalled while processes stay alive (processNotRunning covers crashes only)) → SFM-026, SWF-082: Takeover or disengagement alert not presented; worst cause SFM-026.C1 (UI process hung or display off; O 6, D 10, AP H); detection: No pre-release test targets this cause BE-2.13 (Alert volume not audible (no defined minimum; FFI-CM-18)) → SFM-026: Takeover or disengagement alert not presented; worst cause SFM-026.C1 (UI process hung or display off; O 6, D 10, AP H); detection: No pre-release test targets this cause BE-2.25 (Take-over alert masked by an alert of higher priority but lower urgency (SoftDisableAlert is Priority.MID; alertmanager.py:63)) → SWF-035, SFM-027: Takeover request masked by a lower-urgency alert; worst cause SFM-027.C1 (UI frame drops or audio buffering; O 6, D 10, AP H); detection: No pre-release test targets this cause BE-8.08 (noResponseForceDecel not set, or not turned into a stop: defect in the policy, controlsd or the planner (policy.py:454, controlsd.py:236, longitudinal_planner.py:84)) → SWF-086: Forced deceleration not requested, not passed on, or not carried to a stop after the terminal alert; worst cause SWF-086.C1 (The request crosses three processes with no freshness check on the flag: controlsd reads driverMonitoringState.noResponseForceDecel without an alive or valid check (controlsd.py:49-51, 236), and plannerd reads controlsState.forceDecel the same way (longitudinal_planner.py:84); its own valid flag is not read by controlsd (SWF-065.C1). A stopped dmonitoringd leaves the last value in place until selfdrived soft-disables (SWF-064). BL-007: once the first request arrives, selfdrived latches it (TSR-633, minimum_risk.py) and controlsd keeps forceDecel on from selfdriveState, so a later dmonitoringd stop or reset no longer drops the stop (SWF-062.C1); a request that never arrives, and the unchecked controlsd-to-plannerd link, remain, so O and D are kept; O 5, D 9, AP H); detection: test_longitudinal sets controlsState.forceDecel directly in the plant (CI) and so tests the planner end only; nothing tests the policy-to-controlsd link or a stale flag UE-8.09 (PCM does not execute the stop request (AOU-05R)): No FMEA row needed: external; AOU-05R BE-8.10 (Vehicle not kept stopped, or the item not locked out, after the stop: no standstill hold and no re-engagement or resume lockout until the driver responds (TSR-633 not met, TSR-611 partial)) → SWF-062, SFM-025: Terminal unresponsive-driver state reached without the item reaching the SG-010 safe state; worst cause SWF-062.C1 (Defect in the minimum-risk latch (TSR-633, DQ-365 A, #372, BL-007): selfdrived latches the manoeuvre from the first no-response request until the item disengages (minimum_risk.py, selfdriveState.minimumRiskManeuver), controlsd keeps forceDecel on while it is set, the terminal alert is re-raised while latched and the DM lockout runs from the takeover. A latch that clears while engaged, a forceDecel not held, or a lockout that starts at the stop lets the planner go back to the set speed and the PCM resume from standstill. Up to BL-006 the safe state was not implemented: the forced deceleration was recomputed every frame from the DM request, so a dmonitoringd restart or awareness reset dropped it. The DM events stay PERMANENT alerts by design: the decided safe state keeps lateral control on during the stop; O 5, D 4, AP H); detection: Proven by mutation in CI (after BL-007): the tests fail on each hand-written mutant of this cause (MR-1..MR-7: the latch class, the controlsd forceDecel hold and its hand-off to the car, the alert re-raise in selfdrived and the lockout timing), tools/ci/host_mutation.py in the tests.yaml unit_tests job; so D 4 (RT-2), from D 8 (rev 1.12) UE-8.11 (PCM does not hold the vehicle at standstill under ACC (AOU-16; vehicle test, DQ-365)): No FMEA row needed: external; AOU-16 (WP-C-01): the PCM keeps the vehicle stopped and held under ACC after the no-response stop. Not yet characterised on the reference Corolla; verified by the DQ-365 A vehicle test (level ground and a 6 % grade)

every cause D ≤ 4: tree and FMEA disagree

DM model false negative: eyes off the road or eyes closed
